EC1: - Patients with type 2 [OR] or gestational diabetes
EC2: - Patients with intolerance [OR] or hypersensitivity to metformin
EC3: - Patients with congestive heart failure [OR] or a history of congestive heart failure
EC5: - Patients having current significant gastrointestinal problems such as severe vomiting requiring intravenous fluids [OR] or hospitalization
EC6: - Presence of acute or chronic metabolic acidosis, including diabetic ketoacidosis, a history of diabetic ketoacidosis [OR] or history of lactic acidosis
EC8: - Patients with known higher order pregnancies (twins, [OR] triplets, etc.)
EC9: - Patients having a known potentially fetal lethal anomaly
